root_idea.summary: A root orientation toward silence, muteness, and closure: being shut off from speech, sound, or an opening.
root_idea.development: The lexical development extends from silence and speechlessness to solitary or soundless things, solid or closed objects, unmixed materials, thick milk, and related idioms of purpose or completion.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular active-participle citation form صَامِتٌ rather than the attested plural surface form.

senses.definition: Silent; not speaking or remaining mute.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is the plural predicate أَنتُمْ صَامِتُونَ, contrasted with calling the addressees; the construction denotes not speaking and does not itself require inability to speak.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Silence functioning as tacit consent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially in the conventional marriage-consent expression in which a virgin's silence counts as her permission.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Non-vocal property, especially gold and silver, contrasted with vocal livestock.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the expression مَا لَهُ صَامِتٌ وَلَا نَاطِقٌ, صامت denotes gold or silver, while ناطق denotes camels, sheep, goats, or other animals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make or render someone silent, mute, or speechless.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Causative Form II.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To quiet a child with food or a similar thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized causative use referring to something given to stop a child's crying or quiet it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To quiet someone by attending to his complaint or caring about his grievance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of inclining sympathetically toward the person who complains, thereby quieting him.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To suffice to quiet or satisfy someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said specifically of food or drink that does or does not quiet the person consuming it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something solid and without a cavity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a thing made non-hollow and consequently generally non-sonorous.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of land, to become altered into rugged or hard ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes land left untilled and unsown for a period and developing rugged patches.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become tongue-tied and cease speaking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported especially of a sick person who is unable to speak.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Silence, muteness, or speechlessness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive corresponding to صَمْتٌ and related silence nouns.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A food or similar item used to quiet a child, or provision that feeds and quiets a household.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A date or another pleasing morsel may be called the child's quieting item; the term can also refer to food sufficient for a family.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Anything at all, in the idiom “I tasted nothing.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the negative expression مَا ذُقْتُ صَمَاتًا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing with which someone is struck or afflicted so as to be silenced.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression رَمَاهُ بِصُمَاتِهِ, “he afflicted him with something that silenced him.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thirst, or a tendency to become thirsty quickly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of people and beasts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Purpose, intention, or the point of accomplishing an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In expressions such as عَلَى صِمَاتِ الأَمْرِ, it can mean being resolved upon or close to accomplishing the matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A position near people, within their sight or hearing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the expression بَاتَ مِنَ القَوْمِ عَلَى صِمَاتٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Soundless in use; making no noise when worn, applied, or driven into something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to quiet armor or anklets, and to a sword or blow that penetrates among the bones without recoiling to make a sound.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Full and without an empty cell.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a honeycomb whose cells are all filled.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Habitually or for a long time silent or mute.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive description applied to a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A counted group of camels, especially twenty camels or the like.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage applied to camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thick milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive usage applied to milk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A deserted or waterless tract in which one has no companion or known whereabouts.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the proper-name expressions وَحْشُ إِصْمِتَ and بَلْدَةُ إِصْمِتَ for a solitary desert place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Made or rendered silent, mute, or speechless.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The primary adjectival/passive sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Solid, not hollow, and without a cavity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived sense associated with the absence of sound from a non-hollow object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Closed or locked so that its opening cannot be found.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a door, lock, or similar enclosure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Uniform and unmixed, consisting of one material or one color.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a one-color garment or horse, a vessel without silver ornament, a one-piece helmet, or an ornament not intermixed with another; an ornament may also be explained as fixed fast so that it does not move.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A heavy sleeper.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative description of the fهد.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of Arabic letters, any letter outside the letters of ذلاقة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: الحروف المصمتة are defined as all letters except those comprised in مُرْ بِنَفْلٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tongue-tied and not speaking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to a sick person unable to speak.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Complete or made up in full.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression أَلْفٌ مُصَمَّتٌ, “a completed thousand.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: A silencer or quieter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A person or thing that causes another to become quiet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who attends to another's complaint and cares for his case.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a sympathetic respondent, especially in proverbial or poetic speech.
